style_notes: Preserve source typography, geometry, visual hierarchy, diagrams, imagery, logos, and data colors.
No semantic color roles added; source data/actor/phase colors remain fixed.
opaque_areas: Gauge indicators, filled rating bands, qualitative scale, and table layout are opaque source data visuals; changed row labels do not change the original gauge ratings.
retained_source_content: Fixed gauge levels encode source ratings and remain unchanged; do not interpret them as scores for the illustrative comparison fields.
limitations: Fixed text-binding cardinality; text flow and fit are not measured.
Source-only diagrams, charts, screenshots and their labels remain opaque unless specifically editable text slots.
Native rendering, visual fit, adaptation qualification, and application of example values have not been performed by this lane.
Gauge needles and summary scale positions are retained source examples, not computed assessment results; worksheet copy is illustrative.
